question: What is the standard voltage supply used in households?
solution:
The correct answer is __**220 Volt AC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electricity voltage is supplied to our houses at **220 volt.**
 
• Frequency of the A.C. supplied to our houses is 50 Hz respectively.
 
• The appliances are arranged in parallel circuits in households. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The electricity from the mains is supplied to the houses using three-core wiring. They are
 
 
• The Live wire
 
• The neutral wire and
 
• The earth wire
 
 
 
• Live Wire: 
 
 
• It is at a high potential of 220 volts.
 
• The live wire has red insulation.
 
 
 
• Neutral wire: 
 
 
• It is at the ground potential of zero volt. 
 
• The neutral wire has black insulation covering.
 
 
 
• Earth wire: 
 
 
• It is a safety measure and does not affect the supply in any way.
 
• The green earth wire is connected to a metal plate deep in the earth.
